title: 2017 AMC 10B Problem 7
statement:
Samia set off on her bicycle to visit her friend, traveling at an average speed of \(17\) kilometers per hour. When she had gone half the distance to her friend’s house, a tire went flat, and she walked the rest of the way at \(5\) kilometers per hour.

In all, it took her \(44\) minutes to reach her friend’s house. In kilometers rounded to the nearest tenth, how far did Samia walk?

solutions.text:
Let \(d\) be the distance Samia walked. She bicycled the same distance, so her total travel time gives \[\dfrac{d}{17}+\dfrac{d}{5}=\dfrac{44}{60}.\] Solving yields \(d=\dfrac{17}{6}=2.833\ldots,\) which rounds to \(2.8\) kilometers.

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: Let the walking distance be \(d\), so the biking distance is also \(d\)
Add the biking time and walking time to get \(44\) minutes
